refused.in-triage: Accept the task from To triage on the PC first.
refused.my-day-full: My Day holds at most 200 tasks.
refused.description-too-long: The description is too long (8,000 characters at most).
refused.bad-estimate: Use a number from 0 to 1,000, or leave it empty.
refused.bad-milestone: That milestone is not in this project.
refused.bad-label: A task has at most 20 labels of 80 characters each.
refused.bad-checklist-line: A checklist has at most 30 items of 500 characters each, and each one different.
refused.too-deep: Subtasks can only be nested three levels deep.
refused.bad-dependency: A task can only wait on another task of its project. A subtask can only wait on subtasks next to it.
refused.dependency-loop: That would make tasks wait on each other in a loop.
refused.bad-reminder-time: Choose a time in the future, within ten years.
refused.task-closed: A finished, archived or deleted task takes no new reminders.
refused.choice-too-long: That option is too long (300 characters at most).
refused.note-too-long: The note is too long (2000 characters at most).
refused.not-waiting: This task has moved on since: it is no longer waiting on you.

advancedSync.heading: Advanced sync (Cloudflare R2)
advancedSync.intro: Sync through your own Cloudflare R2 bucket instead of Google Drive. On your PC, open Settings › Devices › Advanced sync, set up the bucket and make a setup code. Paste it here with its passphrase.
advancedSync.imported: Bucket set up. Now use Set up from my other device above, unless this phone is already one of your devices.
advancedSync.notACode: That isn't a setup code. Copy the whole code, starting with ostler-r2:.
advancedSync.wrongPassphrase: That passphrase doesn't open this code.
advancedSync.syncFailed: Couldn't reach the bucket. Check your connection and try again.
advancedSync.checkEvery: Look for changes from your other devices:
advancedSync.costNote: While the app is open. Your own changes go up a few seconds after you make them. R2's free tier allows plenty for one person; a longer interval uses less.
advancedSync.passphraseIs: The code is in the share sheet. Its passphrase, to type or send separately:
